body.p: AMENDMENTS TO THE CLAIMSThis listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application.
body.br:
Claim 1. (Currently Amended): A system comprising:
an insertable cardiac monitor (ICM) comprising:a housing configured for subcutaneous implantation within a patient, the housing having a length extending from a proximal end of the housing to a distal end of the housing, a width, and a depth,
wherein the length is greater than the width and the width is greater than the depth, and
wherein the length is within a range from 40 millimeters (mm) to 60 mm;
a heart sound sensor, wherein the ICM is configured to sense heart sounds of the patient via the heart sound sensor; and
a plurality of electrodes on the housing, wherein the ICM is configured to sense an electrocardiogram (ECG) of the patient via the plurality of electrodes;
a remote computing device; and
processing circuitry of at least one of the insertable cardiac monitor or the remote computing device, the processing circuitry configured to:periodically determine a respective value for each of a plurality of physiological parameters based on one or more of the heart sounds or the ECG, wherein at least a first physiological parameter of the plurality of physiological parameters is determined based on the heart sounds and at least a second physiological parameter of the plurality of physiological parameters is determined based on the ECG, wherein the first physiological parameter comprises a frequency of occurrence of an S3 heart sound;
output trends of the periodically determined values of the physiological parameters at the remote computing device; and
determine whether to present an indication of a heart failure event based on an analysis of the trends of the periodically determined values of the physiological parameters, wherein to perform the analysis of the trends the processing circuitry is configured to:
determine a first variation value of at least one physiological parameter of the plurality of physiological parameters for a first period and a second variation value of the at least one of the physiological parameter for a second period preceding the first period; and
determine whether a comparison of the first variation value and the second variation value satisfies a criterion.
Claim 2. (Canceled).
Claim 3. (Previously Presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the indication of the heart failure event comprises an indication of a risk of the heart failure event.
Claim 4. (Previously Presented): The system of claim 1, wherein to determine whether to present the indication of the heart failure event based on an analysis of the trends of the periodically determined values of the physiological parameters, the processing circuitry is configured to apply respective weights to each of the plurality of physiological parameters.
Claim 5. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of physiological parameters comprise a measurement of an Si heart sound.
Claim 6. (Canceled).
Claim 7. (Previously Presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of physiological parameters comprise one or more of: a morphological measurement of an Sl and/or S2 heart sound, or a presence/frequency of an S4 heart sound.
Claim 8. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of physiological parameters comprise a morphological measurement of an Si heart sound.
Claim 9. (Canceled).
Claim 10. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the ICM comprises a patient activity sensor configured to sense activity/posture of the patient, and the processing circuitry is configured to periodically determine values of at least one physiological parameter of the plurality of physiological parameters based on the sensed activity/posture.
Claim 11. (Previously Presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the ICM comprises one or more accelerometers, and the processing circuitry is configured to periodically determine values of at least one physiological parameter of the plurality of physiological parameters based on a signal from the one or more accelerometers.
Claim 12. (Canceled).
Claim 13. (Previously Presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the processing circuitry is configured to determine whether to present the indication of the heart failure event based on a comparison of a physiological parameter value for a current period to a threshold determined based on physiological parameter values for previous periods.
Claim 14. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of physiological parameters comprises at least one of a heart rate variability parameter or a night heart rate parameter.
Claim 15. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the housing defines an elongated rectangular prism comprising a rounded distal end and a rounded proximal end.
Claim 16. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the plurality of electrodes comprises a first electrode that is substantially flat and a second electrode that comprises a three-dimensional, curved configuration.
Claim 17. (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein a volume of the ICM is less than 1.5 cubic centimeters.
